topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I found out today that someone took my art, something I poured hours and solitude into, and etched it onto their skin. It’s a strange feeling, seeing a fragment of yourself permanently embedded in someone else’s flesh. I suppose it’s a form of recognition, a sort of compliment. But it feels more like a piece of me was taken without asking, a quiet theft in the night. I wonder if they understand the depth of what they inked, or if it's just an image to them, devoid of the sweat and whispers of creation.
